children: Vitaspring Biomedical appointed Jing-Zhou Chen as Chief Executive Officer, President, Chief Financial Officer and Secretary and elected Shao-Hsiang Shih as Chairman following Dr. Ssu-Chuan Lai’s resignation from multiple roles.
Chairperson of the Board; Chief Executive Officer; President; Chief Financial Officer; Secretary; Board member
Chief Executive Officer; President; Chief Financial Officer; Secretary; Principal executive & financial officer
Sept 7, 2026 (elected at 11:56 p.m. PT; appointed Chairman at 11:57 p.m. PT)
Not the result of any disagreement with the Company on operations, policies or practices
Successor officers appointed (Jing-Zhou Chen assumed officer roles)

Age 40; founder & CEO of Dream Born Co., Ltd. since Mar 2025; prior CEO roles at GBT Cloud Kitchen/Hongxi Enterprise Management (2020–2025); co-founder POKE25 (2018–2020); VP Operations at G-Store (2017–2018); earlier engineering roles; B.S. EE; enrolled in Executive MBA

Age 54; Director of Administrative Management of Century Publishing since 2020; prior Director of Education Management roles; bachelor's in Statistics; master's in Buddhist Studies; doctoral student in Eastern Humanistic Thought
Designated principal executive officer, principal financial officer and principal accounting officer; entitled to indemnification (agreement not yet executed)
Appointed Chairman; not appointed to any committee; entitled to indemnification (agreement not yet executed)
